card.fact_statement: Firefighters had to cut open the rear of the bus after the 2025 Gerik bus crash.
card.source_span: Firefighters had to cut open the rear of the bus to extricate trapped victims.

target_qa_variants.question: Ni kitendo gani cha kimwili ambacho wazima moto walilazimika kufanya kwenye basi baada ya ajali ya basi ya Gerik ya mwaka 2025?
target_qa_variants.expected_answer: kukata na kufungua sehemu ya nyuma
target_qa_variants.source_span: Firefighters had to cut open the rear of the bus to extricate trapped victims.
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'physical intervention' as 'kitendo cha kimwili' (physical action) for natural phrasing in Swahili. 'cut open the rear' translated as 'kukata na kufungua sehemu ya nyuma'.

backtranslation_en.question: What physical action did firefighters have to perform on the bus after the 2025 Gerik bus crash?
backtranslation_en.expected_answer: cut and open the back part

backtranslation_consistency.reason: The target language QA accurately translates the source question and expected answer, preserving the exact fact and relation.
